preamble: Names of a distinguished family have only partial clues

clue.text: Most unpleasant to inhale and you want to kiss me!

indicators.note: read as 'you want it rearranged': the setter invites the solver to rework these letters as desired

explanation.surface: A smoker's breath may be foul, yet the smoker still asks for a kiss.
explanation.walkthrough: 'you want' signals rearranging TOKISSME into the answer; 'and' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Air that is the most smoke-laden is the most unpleasant thing to breathe in.

clue.text: Counters Cameron's trick

indicators.note: 's here means has: the words before it hold the hidden answer

explanation.surface: A political leader's rebuttals are dismissed as a con.
explanation.walkthrough: The answer runs across the end of 'Counters' and the start of 'Cameron's'; the setter gives no separate signal for the extraction.
explanation.definitionFit: A con or swindle is a trick played on someone.

clue.text: With loss of leader, famine grips numbers back in state capital

indicators.note: the shortened word holds the next piece inside it
the leading letter of the famine word is dropped

parts.note: a famine is a scarcity of food

indicators.note: the abbreviation for numbers is read from right to left

explanation.surface: A state capital in a time of famine, with the numbers of hungry people falling back.
explanation.walkthrough: 'back' reverses the abbreviation for numbers before 'grips' places it inside CARCITY; Carson City is in Nevada.
explanation.definitionFit: Carson City is the capital of the US state of Nevada.

clue.text: Map one may be as thick as?

definitions.meaning: to map out is to devise a scheme

definitions.text: one may be as thick as?
definitions.meaning: the saying 'as thick as a short plank' describes a dim person; a short plank, cut short, gives the answer

explanation.definitionFit: To map something out is to draw up a scheme or design for it.

clue.text: Across solution can't possibly be immune

indicators.note: possibly signals that the letters may be arranged another way

explanation.surface: A solver insists one across answer cannot possibly be challenged.
explanation.walkthrough: 'possibly' rearranges ACROSS and CANT; 'solution' is a link with crossword flavour.
explanation.definitionFit: Something sacrosanct is held too sacred to be attacked, as if it were immune.

clue.text: King's 19

definitions.meaning: King's ... is a market town in the English county of Norfolk
... Redgrave was an actress of the family named at 19

explanation.definitionFit: The town name completes King's Lynn, and Lynn Redgrave was an English actress.

clue.text: See 26
See 24
West German puzzler on the inside left by 19

indicators.note: the German first person goes within the film star's first name

parts.note: Mae West was the American film star
the puzzler is the setter, who calls himself I, and German for I is ich

explanation.surface: A West German setter of puzzles keeps to the inside left, as a footballer might.
explanation.walkthrough: 'West' is not a direction but Mae West; 'by' is a link to the family at 19.
explanation.definitionFit: Sir Michael Redgrave was the actor at the head of the family the puzzle celebrates.

clue.text: Whenever against me you start intervening

indicators.note: that letter comes between the parts of the word for against

parts.note: anti means against

indicators.note: the opening letter of the word you is taken

explanation.surface: Someone says a rival may start trouble with them whenever they like.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means at any moment one likes, the sense of whenever.

clue.text: Boy member thus absorbed

indicators.note: the boy's name takes the other two pieces inside it

parts.note: Ken is a boy's name
MP stands for Member of Parliament
so means thus

explanation.surface: A boy who became a member of Parliament was thus swallowed up by politics.
explanation.walkthrough: Rachel Kempson, wife of Michael Redgrave, is one of the family whose clue is only wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: Rachel Kempson, the actress who married Sir Michael Redgrave, belongs to the distinguished family the preamble names.

clue.text: Steers here when 11's left out, keeping name

indicators.note: the shortened name holds the next letter
the letter L, for left, is taken out

parts.note: the person at 11 is Rachel Kempson, so her first name with the possessive gives the letters

explanation.surface: Cattle steering needs no Rachel, but someone must keep the name.
explanation.walkthrough: 'left out' removes L from RACHELS to leave RACHES, which holds N.
explanation.definitionFit: Ranches are large farms where steers, young bullocks, are raised.

clue.text: Fellows from Europe with date making sisters furious

indicators.note: the fellows come from Europe, so the European abbreviation is placed first and the men follow it

parts.note: EU is the abbreviation for the European Union
men means fellows
the Ides is a date in the Roman calendar, mid-month

explanation.surface: Men from Europe kept a date that made their sisters angry.
explanation.walkthrough: The Eumenides, 'kindly ones', is the Greek euphemism for the Furies.
explanation.definitionFit: In Greek myth the Furies were avenging sister goddesses, called by this name to appease them.

clue.text: Ground breakers from Milton Keynes dropping bits and swallowing tonic

indicators.note: the trimmed town name takes the next piece inside it
some scattered letters of the town name fall away, leaving the rest in order

parts.note: Milton Keynes is a new town in Buckinghamshire, England
ut is the old name for the first note, the tonic, of the scale

explanation.surface: Diggers from a new English town are dropped while drinking tonic.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dropping bits' removes I, L, T and E from MILTONKEYNES, leaving MONKEYNS, which takes in UT.
explanation.definitionFit: These are peanuts, also called groundnuts; the plant pushes its pods into the soil to ripen.

clue.text: Hurried off as smoother on Monday morning etc

definitions.text: as smoother on Monday morning etc
definitions.meaning: the folk song 'Dashing Away with the Smoothing Iron' has a maid ironing on each day of the week

explanation.definitionFit: To dash away is to hurry off; the song's maid also dashes away with her smoothing iron.

clue.text: Sovereign in itself?

indicators.note: one sense of the word is placed inside the other

parts.note: a sovereign is a gold coin
R, for Rex or Regina, stands for a reigning sovereign

explanation.surface: A question whether a sovereign contains itself.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sovereign' gives both the coin and the ruler; 'itself' says the word is put inside its own other sense. Corin Redgrave was Michael's son.
explanation.definitionFit: Corin Redgrave, actor son of Sir Michael, is one of the family members the preamble says get only wordplay.

clue.text: Sorry about bus stopping too soon to take part

indicators.note: the word for sorry goes round the next piece

parts.note: contrite means sorry

indicators.note: the bus halts before its last letter

explanation.surface: An apology for a bus that stopped short of the stop where people wanted to join in.
explanation.walkthrough: 'stopping too soon' removes the last letter of BUS to give BU.
explanation.definitionFit: To contribute is to play a part in or share in something.

clue.text: Labour's getting round the polls (they say): if inflamed, one may take them out

definitions.text: if inflamed, one may take them out

indicators.note: the word for labours goes round the poles

parts.note: toils means labours

indicators.note: signals a word spoken that sounds like another

parts.note: said aloud this is like the poles, north and south, N and S

explanation.surface: The Labour party campaigns all over the country at the polls, and some may want to remove it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'the polls' is heard as 'the poles', the North and South poles, N and S.
explanation.definitionFit: A surgeon may remove inflamed tonsils in a tonsillectomy.

clue.text: New burden placed on monarch who keeps off the grass

indicators.note: the first two pieces come before the last, as if placed on it in the order of reading

parts.note: an onus is a burden
ER is Elizabeth Regina, the Queen

explanation.surface: A new burden is laid on the monarch, who must stay off the lawn.
explanation.walkthrough: 'keeps off the grass' plays on the drug sense of grass: someone who does not use it.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who abstains from cannabis, slang grass, is one who does not use it.

clue.text: Left to the last?

parts.note: red is the colour of the political left
the grave is the last resting place, as in from cradle to grave

explanation.surface: Someone asks whether something was left until the very end.
explanation.walkthrough: The family name, fitting the Redgraves' left-wing politics.
explanation.definitionFit: The distinguished acting family of the preamble bears this surname, shared by Michael, Vanessa, Corin and Lynn.

clue.text: Sweet lassie's little city 7

parts.note: jo is a Scots word for a sweetheart
Ely in Cambridgeshire is one of England's smallest cities

explanation.surface: A Scottish girl's tiny city is named after a family.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is the surname at 7, of Tony and Vanessa's daughter.
explanation.definitionFit: Joely Richardson is the actress daughter of Vanessa Redgrave and Tony Richardson.

clue.text: Doing a dance with one that holds French liquor

indicators.note: the dance contains the French wine

parts.note: one refers back to a dance, here a jig
vin is French for wine

explanation.surface: Dancing while carrying a glass of cognac.
explanation.walkthrough: 'one' stands for a dance, a JIG.
explanation.definitionFit: To jive is to perform a lively jazz dance, so jiving means doing that dance.

clue.text: Sitting third in Preston North End line-up

indicators.note: the third letter of the town name is taken
a team's line-up arranges players, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A football team placed third in the Preston North End team sheet.
explanation.walkthrough: Preston North End is an English football club. 'line-up' rearranges E with NORTHEND.
explanation.definitionFit: A monarch who sits on the throne is installed there formally.

clue.text: Direction indicators as redirected by 19

parts.note: weather vanes show the direction of the wind

indicators.note: turned back, the little word is read from right to left

explanation.surface: Indicators showing the way are redirected by the family at 19.
explanation.walkthrough: 'redirected' turns AS into SA; 'by' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Vanessa Redgrave is an actress and daughter of Michael Redgrave.

clue.text: Average appeal gets nothing

parts.note: SOS is a distress call, an appeal for help
O looks like zero

explanation.surface: An average plea for help gets no response.
explanation.definitionFit: Middling or mediocre is the sense of the hyphenated phrase.

clue.text: High hitter goes to pot

definitions.meaning: a player who lobs the ball high, as in tennis
a crustacean caught in a pot and boiled in another

explanation.definitionFit: One who lobs hits high; the shellfish is trapped in pots and cooked in them.

clue.text: Number spotted when letters turned up

indicators.note: in a down light all the pieces read from bottom to top

parts.note: seen means spotted
mail is letters

explanation.surface: A number of letters were spotted when they turned up in the post.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turned up' reverses the whole run, NOSEENMAIL, to give the actor's name. He married Natasha Richardson, Vanessa's daughter.
explanation.definitionFit: The Northern Irish actor married Natasha Richardson, joining the distinguished acting family by marriage.

clue.text: Award for 19

definitions.meaning: the theatre prize given on Broadway
... Richardson, film director, was married to Vanessa Redgrave

explanation.definitionFit: The Antoinette Perry prize for theatre is so named, and Tony Richardson married into the family.

clue.text: Alas! the devil's returned to take our idol — cruel's the incursion

indicators.note: both the cry and the devil's name are read backwards as one run

parts.note: ah is a cry of grief
Satan is the devil
R, for recipe, is the abbreviation for take in prescriptions

indicators.note: an incursion breaks in, so the cruel word goes inside the idol

parts.note: an icon is an idol
hard's means cruel's, with the possessive giving an S

explanation.surface: A lament that a cruel death has taken a beloved star.
explanation.walkthrough: Written soon after the actress's death in March 2009, so 'to take our idol' doubles as a lament; 'returned' turns the cry and the devil's name around as one run.
explanation.definitionFit: Vanessa Redgrave's elder daughter was an actress who died after a skiing fall in 2009, so she belongs to the family.

clue.text: Not a different month for Russian flier

indicators.note: the letters are made different by being rearranged

parts.note: NOV is short for November

explanation.surface: A Russian aircraft flies only in a month other than November.
explanation.definitionFit: Antonov is a maker of Soviet and Ukrainian aircraft, so its planes fly.
